contact.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to common questions about getting in touch and using Slipzen.
contact.faq1Q: How fast will your team respond to my message?
contact.faq1A: Our customer support team typically responds to WhatsApp and live chat inquiries within 5 to 15 minutes during operating hours (9 AM - 8 PM IST). Emails are replied to within 4 to 12 hours.
contact.faq2Q: Do you help with thermal printer setup and drivers?
contact.faq2A: Yes! If you have a thermal printer (USB, Bluetooth, or Network ESC/POS) and need assistance configuring it with Slipzen, our technical team can guide you step-by-step or connect via screen share.
contact.faq3Q: Can I request a custom receipt template for my business?
contact.faq3A: Absolutely. If you require special fields, barcodes, specific HSN formatting, or unique branding layouts, reach out to us and we can configure a custom template for your store.
contact.faq4Q: Does Slipzen work on mobile phones and tablets?
contact.faq4A: Yes. Slipzen is 100% web-based and responsive. You can open it on your Android or iPhone and connect to Bluetooth thermal printers directly.
